title: 第19章 奉献本源幽冥之主第20章 讲道结束众人碰壁
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
帝江感受着体内初步成型的阴阳法则，那玄妙的道韵让他对万物运转有了更深的理解。
他看着眼前在五行光球中缓缓旋转，吞吐能量的幽冥界雏形，一个更大胆更具野心的念头涌上心头。
“仅仅依靠五行之力的被动滋养，幽冥界的演化速度还是太慢了。
鸿钧讲道已近尾声，天道大势的车轮即将加速滚动，留给我的时间不多了。”
帝江目光灼灼，必须让幽冥界更快成长，并且，要确保它绝对在我的掌控之中！
分润自身本源，融入这方未成形的世界！
此举风险极大，本源关乎根基，一旦有失，轻则修为倒退，重则伤及性命。
但收益也同样惊人！
若能成功，他将提前成为这未来的幽冥之主！
风险与机遇并存，帝江乃盘古精血所化，身负开天功德，血脉与洪荒同源！
他的本源，或许正是这初生幽冥界发展最好的催化剂！
帝江深吸一口气，调动起沉淀于血脉深处的盘古之力，随即并指如刀，猛地点在自身眉心祖窍之上！
一声道鸣自他体内响起，一滴蕴含着难以想象能量的精血，裹挟着他一丝凝练的元神意念以及时空、五行、风雨雷电等诸多法则的碎片，缓缓自眉心逼出。
这滴精血并非寻常的祖巫精血，而是融入了帝江一丝根本源力的“本源精血”
其色混沌，其表有无数细微的法则符文流转生灭，散发着古老、苍茫、包容万象的磅礴气息。
逼出这滴本源精血，帝江的脸色瞬间苍白了几分，气息也出现了明显的波动与下滑，显然损耗巨大。
“去！”
帝江低喝一声，手掐道诀，操控着那滴本源精血，缓缓飞向前方的五行光球。
先天五方旗似乎感应到了这滴精血中与洪荒同源的气息，非但没有排斥，反而主动散开一道缝隙，让本源精血顺利融入核心处的灰色气团——幽冥界雏形之中！
就在本源精血融入的刹那，仿佛开天辟地般的一声巨响在帝江的元神中炸开！

那原本缓慢演化的幽冥界雏形，如同被注入了最狂暴的催化剂，瞬间剧烈膨胀、翻滚起来！
灰色的至阴之气疯狂涌动，其中开始清晰地分化出清浊之意。
帝江的本源精血化作无数最细微的法则丝线，如同世界的脉络，迅速蔓延至幽冥界的每一个角落。
他的时空法则碎片，开始稳定这方初生世界的空间结构，开始衍生出独特的时间流速；五行法则碎片融入大地，演化山川河谷，奠定物质基础；风雨雷电的法则碎片在至阴之气的包裹下，化作幽冥界特有的天象与能量潮汐……
更重要的是，帝江那源自盘古的血脉之力，如同最权威的通行证，使得这方初生的幽冥界，几乎毫无阻碍地与洪荒主世界产生了最深层次的连接！
洪荒世界的天地法则，如同找到了一个天然的附属位面，开始自发地向幽冥界流淌、填充、完善其规则。
原本可能需要无数元会才能自然演化的进程，在帝江这本源之力的推动下，正以肉眼可见的速度疯狂进行！
而帝江的元神意念，也随着本源的扩散，如同无孔不入的水银，瞬间遍布了整个幽冥界。
他感觉自己仿佛成了这方世界本身！
大地是他的身躯，幽冥之气是他的呼吸，初生的法则脉络是他的思绪！
炼化？根本无需炼化！
当他的本源成为世界基石的那一刻，他就已经是这幽冥界无可争议的主宰！
一种如臂使指、掌控一切的绝对权柄，自然生成！
“成了！”
帝江苍白的脸上露出了极度疲惫却又无比兴奋的笑容。
幽冥界正在飞速扩张、稳固，其内部法则因为融入了他的诸多法则碎片，远比原本天道轨迹中那个纯粹的至阴死寂世界要完善和强大得多！
未来的六道轮回、幽冥地府，其根基将更加牢固，潜力更加无穷！
同时，通过幽冥界这个中介，他也感受到了自身与整个洪荒世界的联系变得更加紧密。
仿佛清晰地聆听到洪荒大地中那源自盘古的脉脉温情。
“自此，幽冥为我，我不为幽冥！”

帝江缓缓握紧拳头，感受着体内虽然虚弱却与整个新生界域紧密相连的本源，以及那随着界域成长而反馈回来的丝丝精纯道韵！
“只待时机一到，便可立轮回，掌秩序，为这方天地，再续乾坤！”
帝江目光穿透盘古神殿，仿佛看到了那未来执掌众生轮回、秩序井然的幽冥世界，而他的身影，将屹立于那世界的顶点！

content_en:
Di Jiang felt the laws of yin and yang that were initially taking shape in his body, and the mysterious Tao rhyme gave him a deeper understanding of the operation of all things.
He looked at the prototype of the Netherworld that was slowly rotating in the five-element light ball and absorbing energy, and a bolder and more ambitious idea came to his mind.
“Relying solely on the passive nourishment of the power of the Five Elements, the evolution of the Netherworld is still too slow.
Hongjun's sermon is coming to an end, and the wheels of heaven's general trend are about to accelerate, and I don't have much time left. "
Di Jiang's eyes are burning. I must make the Nether World grow faster, and I must make sure that it is absolutely under my control!
Distribute your own origins and integrate into this unformed world!
This move is extremely risky. The origin is related to the foundation. Once it is missed, the cultivation will be regressed, and the life will be hurt in the worst case.
But the benefits are just as amazing!
If he succeeds, he will become the future Lord of the Netherworld in advance!
Risks and opportunities coexist. Dijiang is transformed from the essence and blood of Pangu. He is responsible for the merits of opening the sky, and his bloodline is the same as that of the prehistoric times!
His origin may be the best catalyst for the development of this nascent Netherworld!
Di Jiang took a deep breath, mobilized the power of Pangu that had accumulated in the depths of his blood, and then pointed his fingers like a knife sharply at the ancestral orifice between his eyebrows!
A scream rang out from his body, and a drop of blood essence containing unimaginable energy was slowly forced out from the center of his eyebrows, wrapped in a trace of his condensed soul thoughts and fragments of many laws such as time and space, the five elements, wind, rain, thunder and lightning.
This drop of essence and blood is not the ordinary ancestral witch essence and blood, but the "original essence and blood" that has been blended with a trace of Dijiang's fundamental power.
Its color is chaotic, and there are countless subtle law runes on its surface that circulate and die, exuding an ancient, vast, and all-encompassing majestic atmosphere.
After forcing out this drop of original essence and blood, Di Jiang's face instantly turned pale, and his aura also showed obvious fluctuations and declines. It was obvious that he had suffered a huge loss.
"Go!"
Di Jiang shouted low, made a secret with his hand, controlled the drop of original blood essence, and slowly flew towards the five-element light ball in front.
The Xiantian Five Directions Banner seemed to have sensed the aura of the original essence and blood in this drop of blood. Instead of rejecting it, it took the initiative to spread a gap, allowing the original essence and blood to smoothly integrate into the gray air mass at the core - the prototype of the Netherworld!
At the moment when the original essence and blood merged, a loud noise like the creation of the world exploded in Dijiang's soul!
The prototype of the Netherworld, which was originally evolving slowly, seemed to be injected with the most violent catalyst, and instantly expanded and rolled violently!
The gray Yin Qi surged crazily, and the meaning of purity and turbidity began to be clearly differentiated.
Dijiang's original essence and blood turned into countless tiny threads of law, like the veins of the world, quickly spreading to every corner of the Nether World.
His fragments of the law of time and space began to stabilize the spatial structure of this nascent world and began to derive a unique flow rate of time; fragments of the law of the five elements merged into the earth, evolving mountains and river valleys, laying the material foundation; fragments of the law of wind, rain, thunder and lightning, wrapped in the yin energy, turned into the unique celestial phenomena and energy tides of the Netherworld...
What's more important is that Di Jiang's bloodline power derived from Pangu is like the most authoritative pass, allowing this nascent Netherworld to have the deepest connection with the main world of the prehistoric world without any hindrance!
The laws of heaven and earth in the prehistoric world seemed to have found a natural subsidiary plane, and began to spontaneously flow to the underworld, filling in and perfecting its rules.
The process that might have required countless Yuanhui to evolve naturally is now proceeding crazily at a speed visible to the naked eye, driven by the power of Dijiang!
And Di Jiang's spiritual thoughts also spread with their origin, like pervasive mercury, instantly spreading throughout the Netherworld.
He felt as if he had become the world itself!
The earth is his body, the air of the netherworld is his breath, and the nascent laws and veins are his thoughts!
Refining? No refining required at all!
The moment his origin becomes the cornerstone of the world, heHe is already the undisputed master of the Netherworld!
An absolute authority that controls everything like an arm and a finger is born naturally!
"It's done!"
Di Jiang's pale face showed an extremely tired but extremely excited smile.
The Netherworld is rapidly expanding and stabilizing, and its internal laws are far more complete and powerful than the pure world of death and silence in the original path of heaven because of the integration of many fragments of his laws!
In the future, the Six Paths of Reincarnation and the Netherworld will have a stronger foundation and infinite potential!
At the same time, through the intermediary of the Netherworld, he also felt that his connection with the entire prehistoric world had become closer.
It was as if I could clearly hear the tenderness originating from Pangu in the ancient land.
"From now on, Netherworld is for me, and I am not Netherworld!"
Di Jiang slowly clenched his fists, feeling the origin in his body that although weak was closely connected to the entire new realm, as well as the pure Tao charm that was fed back as the realm grew!
"As long as the time comes, we can establish reincarnation, control order, and restore the universe for this world!"
Di Jiang's gaze penetrated the Pangu Temple, and he seemed to see the orderly netherworld that would govern the reincarnation of all living beings in the future, and his figure would stand at the top of that world!
